# Content style guide

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

From [Brand design](brand-design.md):

- Write each message to a user in the voice of the brand definition. ^write-in-brand-voice

## Definition

The house rules for the writing of an organization: its grammar, its mechanics, its terms, and its voice. GOV.UK keeps an A to Z style guide and a technical A to Z. The Mailchimp Content Style Guide covers the writing goals and principles, the voice and tone, and the grammar and mechanics.
